title: Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 Arrives October 22 With Dual-Wielding Playstyle
excerpt: Free Edgerunners 2 Update teases cyberware customization on PC, PS5 and Xbox, with full patch notes due October 21
body:
• Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5, the Edgerunners 2 Update, launches free on October 22, 2026 for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, with a Nintendo Switch 2 version to follow later.
  • CD Projekt Red has teased cyberware customization and a new dual-wielding playstyle, plus new items and features inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 — the full patch notes arrive October 21.
  • Watch the reveal live: REDstreams airs October 21 at 5 p.m. CEST (11 a.m. ET / 8 a.m. PT) on Twitch, YouTube and Steam.
  • Edgerunners 2 premiered on Netflix on October 20 with all 10 episodes available at once as a standalone story set in Night City.

CD Projekt Red is returning to Night City. The studio has announced Update 2.5 for Cyberpunk 2077, a free patch tied to the premiere of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 that Forbes described as the game's biggest update since the Phantom Liberty expansion. The update launches on October 22, two days after the anime's second season arrived on Netflix.

The timing reverses what players had been led to expect. Game director Gabe Amatangelo had previously suggested the studio was finished with major updates as it shifted focus to other projects, and reporting by gagadget notes the last patch, in July 2025, had been called final. Instead, Cyberpunk 2077, first released in December 2020 and now past 40 million copies sold as of July 2026, is getting another substantial round of content almost six years after launch.

What CD Projekt Red has confirmed

The confirmed outline is deliberately short. In its announcement post, quoted by GameSpot and CGMagazine, the studio wrote: "New Edgerunners, new chrome, new playstyle? Sounds like we need another REDstreams!" It added: "We're talking cyberware customization, a new dual-wielding playstyle, and more."

https://x.com/Gfinity/status/2112544373640671673

Beyond those two headline features, CD Projekt Red says the patch brings content inspired by Edgerunners 2 "as well as a range of other new items and features," in the wording carried in its press release. The studio has not yet published a full feature list, quest details or system changes. Whether any content requires the Phantom Liberty expansion has also not been stated.

Platforms for launch day are PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. A Switch 2 version will follow later, with no date given. The older PlayStation 4 and Xbox One versions stopped receiving updates years ago and are not part of this release.

What is still rumour, not confirmation

Because the full reveal is being held for the stream, a longer list circulating online should be treated as unconfirmed. Early reported patch-note details mentioned in secondary coverage include two new quests, an extended tarot questline, a pistol-focused perk for dual-wielding, an anime radio station, cyberware vendors, extra clothing sets, new hairstyles for V, console mod support outside Switch 2, field-of-view sliders on consoles and DLSS 4.5 on PC. None of that has been confirmed by CD Projekt Red, and gagadget explicitly advises treating even the headline features as unconfirmed in detail until the October 21 stream.

Kotaku raised a smaller piece of speculation from the key art. The promo image shows protagonist V back to back with Weak Kingsley, a character from Edgerunners II, holding guns in both hands. That could hint at new photo mode poses, Kotaku noted, or it could simply be bespoke artwork. The stream will settle it.

Why Edgerunners matters to the game

The pairing is not incidental. The first Edgerunners season in 2022 helped rehabilitate Cyberpunk 2077 after its troubled launch. CD Projekt Red marked it with an update adding Edgerunners-inspired cosmetics, and player numbers surged.

Edgerunners 2 follows the same release pattern: a standalone series, made by CD Projekt Red with Japanese studio TRIGGER, directed by Kai Ikarashi with Kanno Ichigo as lead character designer and Bartosz Sztybor returning as showrunner, story writer and producer. Its story follows a veteran edgerunner, a young cinephile, a chrome-obsessed delinquent and a Snake Nation netrunner in a tale the studio describes as one of vengeance and redemption. All ten episodes are streaming now on Netflix.

What happens next

Players do not have long to wait for specifics. REDstreams airs on Wednesday, October 21 at 5 p.m. CEST, with patch notes expected the same day, followed by the update itself on October 22. Cyberpunk 2 associate game director Pawel Sasko posted that he was "so f***ing hyped" to show what the studio has been working on, according to GameSpot — a hint the studio sees this as more than a cosmetic tie-in.

For the wider studio, the bulk of CD Projekt Red is working on The Witcher IV, and a Cyberpunk sequel is also in development but still years away. Update 2.5 is a bridge: a free, anime-led reason to reinstall, and for Netflix viewers to find a game still being actively changed.
